engine.title: Six rules the engine never bends
engine.sub: No adjectives. These are the steps every job goes through, with no one phoning you.

cells.title: Your identity is stripped
cells.body: Your name, number and company are removed from the brief before any supplier sees it, and a drawing is shared only after your details on it are covered. No cold calls, no inbox flooding.

cells.title: Licence-checked suppliers only
cells.body: Number, authority and expiry are read from the licence itself. An expired licence cannot quote.

cells.title: A comparison report, and every quote
cells.body: The top 3 are levelled on price, completeness and delivery into one report. Every other quote is listed beside it, so the choice stays yours.

cells.title: Incomplete quotes are held
cells.body: A quote missing its price, lead time, validity or warranty is held, with notes telling the supplier exactly what to add. Only a complete quote is shared with you.

cells.title: 3% to reveal, plus the card fee
cells.body: Posting and comparing are free. You pay only to open the one quote you choose: 3% of it plus the card processing fee, both shown in full before you pay. No VAT is charged on the reveal fee.

cells.title: A refund if the supplier stays silent
cells.body: If the supplier you revealed does not respond within 5 working days, everything you paid is refunded through Stripe.

supplierLanding.stepsTitle: From registration to your first quote

steps.title: Register your company
steps.body: Company name, emirate and trade, then a verified mobile and email.

steps.title: Get verified
steps.body: Upload a current trade licence and company profile and accept the supplier terms. Verification takes up to 3 working days.

steps.title: Confirm your scope
steps.body: Confirm the trades you actually do. That scope decides which briefs reach you, from anywhere in the UAE.

steps.title: Quote from the portal
steps.body: Every quote is checked for price, lead time, validity and warranty. An incomplete one is held, with notes on exactly what to add, until it is complete enough to share with the customer.

supplierLanding.ruleBody: When a customer pays to reveal you, reply within 5 working days — we remind you after 3. If you stay silent, everything the customer paid is refunded and you owe the exact amount refunded (the 3% reveal fee plus the card processing fee charged on it), an AED 250 administrative fee, and simple interest at 9% a year (or the maximum lawful rate) from the due date. New matches pause until it is settled.
supplierLanding.honest: QuotesDone is new. There are no completed jobs on the platform yet, so nothing here promises you a pipeline — only that when work arrives, it is matched on fit.
supplierLanding.finalSub: Registration takes a few minutes. Have your trade licence and company profile to hand.

howPage.metaTitle: How QuotesDone works — anonymous quotes, end to end
howPage.metaDesc: How a job in any trade moves through QuotesDone: the brief, matching to verified suppliers, checked quotes, the comparison report and the reveal.
howPage.title: How an anonymous quote works, end to end
howPage.sub: Built for every trade in the UAE, except food & beverage for now. Every step below is what the platform does, not what a person does for you.

steps.title: You describe the job
steps.body: Text, a photo, a drawing or a BOQ. No calls and no site-visit booking.

steps.title: The engine qualifies it
steps.body: It recognises the trade, asks the questions suppliers need answered and lists the documents and approvals they will be held to.

steps.title: Verified suppliers are invited
steps.body: Only verified suppliers who confirm that trade on their profile, from anywhere in the UAE, capped so the job never becomes a bidding flood. Your identity is removed first.

steps.title: Quotes are checked
steps.body: A quote without a price, lead time, validity or warranty is held, with notes telling the supplier what is missing. Only a complete quote reaches you.

steps.title: You compare every quote
steps.body: The top 3 are levelled on price, completeness and delivery into a comparison report you can export as a PDF. Every other quote is listed too, and you can choose any of them.

steps.title: You reveal one — or none
steps.body: Pay 3% of the quote you choose plus the card processing fee, both shown before you pay. Only that supplier learns who you are.

howPage.maskSub: Anonymity runs both ways until you reveal, and the other bidders are never revealed at all.
